cohort: 200 pregnant women who were COVID-19 positive during a two-year period at a hospital in Bihar, India, compared to a control group of pregnant women who were not COVID-19 positive.
finding: The majority of COVID-19 infected pregnant women were asymptomatic or had mild disease, and there were no significant adverse maternal-neonatal outcomes at this phase of the pandemic.
mod_finding: More COVID-19 positive cases (54%) had cesarean deliveries compared to controls (30%).
